result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both charts start at zero, sort the sites by count, label every bar with its value, and use a title that states the pattern. B fits a newsletter better: it has a light background, no gridlines, and a quiet green that picks out the top two sites. A has a dark theme that won't print well, plus gridlines and a framed card. B does break the single-color guideline with its two-tone highlight, and its duplicate table adds a little bulk. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both charts start at zero, sort the sites by count and label every bar with its value. A suits a newsletter better: it uses a light background, has no gridlines, and its title points out the top two sites while they are highlighted in green. B uses a dark theme that would print poorly, and it adds gridlines and an axis even though each bar already shows its value. A's duplicate table is extra, but it doesn't clutter the chart itself.
